## Summary
Build the **telemetry framework**: a versioned, consent-gated, pluggable pipeline that is a strict no-op unless enabled. It must work identically in dev and production and be safe/privacy-preserving.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1: A `TelemetryRecorder` interface with versioned record schemas (run header with seed/schema version/build; per-tick state+input; discrete events).
- AC2: Pluggable sinks behind one interface: a local JSONL dev sink and a remote/production sink stub; a no-op sink used when disabled.
- AC3: **Disabled by default**; explicitly enabled via config/env. A consent flag gates production recording.
- AC4: Bounded overhead/backpressure (ring buffer + batched flush) so recording never stalls gameplay; a documented sampling option.
- AC5: No PII in the schema; secrets/tokens excluded; documented data policy.
- AC6: Unit tests: no-op sink records nothing; JSONL sink round-trips; batching/flush; schema version present.
- AC7: Docs: schema reference + how to enable/disable.
data.title: Telemetry framework: versioned schema, pluggable sinks, consent flag

data.description:
# Add a GitHub link to the main menu

## Problem statement

Players and contributors have no way to discover the project's source code from the game itself.

## Users

- **Player/Contributor:** Sees the game on-screen, wants to find the repo to report bugs, contribute, or learn more.
- **Reviewer/Tester:** Needs quick access to the source during code reviews or gameplay testing.

### User stories

- *As a player who enjoys the game, I can click/tap a visible link on the main menu to open the GitHub repository in a new browser tab, without losing my game session.*
- *As a keyboard user, I can Tab to the GitHub link on the main menu and press Enter to open it.*

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **AC1 — Renders:** A GitHub link (`🐙  GitHub`) is rendered as text in the bottom-left corner of the main menu (`MenuScene`), below the subtitle and at the same Y position as the subtitle. It uses the existing `MENU_TEXT_COLOR` (#00ffff) with the same padding scheme as other buttons.
2. **AC2 — Click opens repo:** Pointer-down on the link opens `https://github.com/SorraTheOrc/AI_Hell` in a new browser tab (`_blank`) with `noopener,noreferrer` flags.
3. **AC3 — Keyboard-accessible:** The link is registered with `FocusManager` after the Leaderboard button (Tab order: Play Game → Watch Demo → Settings → Leaderboard → **GitHub** → Gym Scene Index). Enter/Space on the focused link triggers the same action as a pointer click. Hover highlights the text in `#88ffff` (matching the existing pointer-over pattern).
4. **AC4 — Constant:** The URL is a single exported `const GITHUB_REPO_URL = 'https://github.com/SorraTheOrc/AI_Hell'` in `src/core/constants.ts` (re-exported from `MenuScene` for testability), used as both the display label and the click target.
5. **AC5 — Tests:** Unit tests verify (a) the button renders with the correct label, (b) pointer activation calls `window.open` with the correct URL and target, and (c) keyboard activation via `FocusManager.handleKey` triggers the same `window.open` call.

## Constraints

- **Keyboard parity (GDD §2.1):** No mouse is ever required. The link must be in the Tab cycle.
- **No mouse required:** Use Phaser's existing pointer + keyboard interaction model; no DOM overlay.
- **New tab only:** Always use `_blank` to preserve the game session.
- **Existing pattern:** Must match the visual style of other menu buttons (neon-cyan text, dark background padding).
- **No `FocusManager` changes:** Reuse the existing manager; do not modify its public API.

## Existing state

- `src/scenes/MenuScene.ts` renders 5 controls: Play Game, Watch Demo, Settings, Leaderboard, Gym Scene Index (dev, bottom-right, fixed position).
- All 5 controls use `this.add.text()` with the same visual pattern (fontFamily: monospace, 20px, MENU_TEXT_COLOR, dark background padding).
- A shared `FocusManager` (`src/utils/focusManager.ts`) handles Tab/arrow cycling and Enter/Space activation.
- `window.open` has not been used in `src/` before; Phaser's canvas is the sole rendering surface.

## Desired change

Add a 6th control (`🐙  GitHub`) to the main menu:
- **Position:** Bottom-left, aligned near the bottom edge (X ≈ 16, Y ≈ GAME_HEIGHT − 12), matching the Gym Scene Index button's offset pattern.
- **Activation:** `window.open(GITHUB_REPO_URL, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')` on both pointer and keyboard activation.
- **Tab order:** Between Leaderboard and Gym Scene Index.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/scenes/MenuScene.ts` — Add the GitHub button (render, pointer handler, FocusManager registration).
- `src/core/constants.ts` — Export `GITHUB_REPO_URL`.
- `src/scenes/MenuScene.test.ts` — Add tests for the new button.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Popup blocker:** `window.open` must be called synchronously within the user-gesture event handler; otherwise the browser may block it. Mitigated by calling `window.open` directly in the pointer/keyboard handlers.
- **Tab order change:** Adds a 6th control to the existing 5. The order (Play → Demo → Settings → Leaderboard → GitHub → Gym Index) follows visual hierarchy (top→bottom, left→right).
- **Hardcoded URL:** The repo URL is a constant, not environment-configurable. Acceptable for a personal project; fork maintainers would edit the constant.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q: Where should the GitHub link live, and should it be keyboard-focusable? — Answer (operator): **A** — footer link, bottom-left, pointer-clickable and keyboard-focusable, appended to the Tab cycle. **Recommended** — keeps the GDD keyboard-parity contract intact.
- Q: How should activation behave? — Answer (operator): **A** — open in a new browser tab via `window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')`. **Recommended** — preserves the game session.
- Q: Where should the URL come from? — Answer (operator): **A** — single exported constant (`GITHUB_REPO_URL` in `src/core/constants.ts`), used for both label and click target. **Recommended** — testable, single source of truth.

## Related work

- **MenuScene Settings button** (AH-0MUA8BLMA003U18N) — Similar pattern of adding a button to MenuScene.
- **In-game menu keyboard support (PauseScene)** (AH-0MUBZUQBL0080B88) — Keyboard navigation convention.
- **Add published game URL to top of README** (AH-0MUK3HYC3001YU05) — Same project URL, different location.
- **Create Main Menu scene** (AH-0MU72YVFR005VB2N) — Parent menu work.

data.comment:
Design: implementing the framework as a self-contained `src/telemetry/` module (no PlayScene wiring — that is child 3, AH-0MUY08VVQ007HSSH).

- `schema.ts`: `TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION` + discriminated records (`run_header`, `tick`, `event`) with a JSON-safe payload type.
- `redact.ts`: recursive PII/secret redaction + JSON-safety sanitiser applied at the recorder boundary so nothing sensitive reaches any sink (AC5).
- `sinks.ts`: one `TelemetrySink` interface; `NoopTelemetrySink`, `JsonlTelemetrySink` (pluggable line writer, local-storage dev writer), `RemoteTelemetrySink` stub.
- `config.ts`: disabled by default; env/config resolution; production recording gated on the consent flag.
- `recorder.ts`: `TelemetryRecorder` interface; bounded ring buffer + batched, serialised async flush (never blocks); tick sampling.
- `docs/TELEMETRY.md`: schema reference, enable/disable, sampling, backpressure, data policy.

Tests cover the AC6 list: no-op sink writes nothing, JSONL round-trip, batching/flush, schema version present.
